newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Labour Office says some job problems remain.
newsitem.headline: German Labour Office says some job problems remain.

text.p: German Labour Office President Bernhard Jagoda said on Thursday that the main problems delaying new job creation were still in the building sector but that the worst could be over in manufacturing.

The latest data from the Nuremberg-based agency show German unemployment rose to a seasonally-adjusted 4.316 million in February, an increase of 5,000 from January. The unemployment rate, based on unadjusted data, was unchanged at 12.2 percent.

"In non-construction related manufacturing areas, the rise in unemployment was noticeably smaller than overall. This could mean that the worst is over in job losses in the manufacturing industry," Jagoda told a news conference.
But the German economy provided no new stimulus in February that could boost job creation, he added.
